parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The next page token from a previous response. Use this token to retrieve the next page of results. Leave this parameter empty for the first request.

parameters.name: Q
parameters.description: The search keyword for a fuzzy search on MCP Server names.

parameters.name: Visibility
parameters.description: The visibility level for filtering the results.
